facts.fact: The Bureau des Normes de Madagascar (BNM), the national standards body (Organisme National de Normalisation), was created by decree no. 98-944 of 4 November 1998 and is now governed by decree no. 2014-1570 of 30 September 2014; the document names no information technology or data standard.

systems.owner: Ministry of Commerce (technical oversight), Ministry of Finance (budget oversight)

note: The BNM has a certification department, but the document names no certification against an IT or data standard and no certified organisation, so no certification fact.
